Jagged black plate mail filled with a cloud of biting black flies. No flesh, glaring red eyes. Wings are swarms.

AC 21 (+2 plate and +2 shield), HP 105, ATK 4 +2 longsword +10 (1d8+2) and swarm master, MV far (fly), S +6, D +5, C +6, I +6, W +5, Ch +6, AL C, LV 22

Impervious. Cold immune. Only damaged by silver or magical sources. Lord of the Flies. When attacked or a hostile spell is cast at Baalzebul, CHA 18+ or the attacker instead kneels in supplication.

Swarm Master. Swarms will not harm Baalzebul, and he can command them.

Usurpation. When a spell is cast within double near of Baalzebul, he may choose to have the spell also effect him.
